description:
Create, list, print, copy, delete and render notes, each identified by its stem (filename without .md, e.g. 2026-09-10-14-30-00).

Subcommands:
  new --type TYPE --topic TOPIC --thread THREAD [--thread THREAD]... [--person PERSON]... [--counterparty TEXT] [--location TEXT] — create a note; prints its path
  list [FILTER] [--json] — stem, date, type, threads, topic of every note, oldest first
  cat STEM — print a note
  last — print the path of the newest note
  copy STEM — copy to a new timestamp; topic gets ' COPY'
  delete STEM -y — permanently delete a note
  pdf STEM [--out DIR] — render to markdown and PDF (callouts, action table); prints both paths
  minutes STEM [--out DIR] — render meeting minutes (agreements, resolutions, action items)
  agenda STEM [--out DIR] — render a meeting agenda (outcome sections emptied)

Flags:
  new:
    --type  required; one of Meeting, Correspondence, Workshop, Report, Log, Research, Recipe
    --topic  required; what the note is about; non-empty
    --thread  required; thread name, 'Kind/Name' or wikilink; repeatable; the note is filed under the first
    --person  Meeting and Correspondence only; an attendee; repeatable; linked when people/<Name>.md exists
    --counterparty  Meeting only; the other party
    --location  Meeting only; where it was held
  list:
    FILTER  optional case-insensitive text matched in any column
    --json  JSON output
  delete:
    -y, --yes  required to confirm
  pdf, minutes, agenda:
    --out DIR  output directory; default the user's Downloads folder. Writes <stem>.md and <stem>.md.pdf

Examples:
  ["new", "--type", "Meeting", "--topic", "Quarterly review", "--thread", "Projects/SGB", "--person", "Riaz Arbi", "--location", "Cape Town"]
  ["list", "SGB", "--json"]
  ["cat", "2026-09-10-14-30-00"]
  ["minutes", "2026-09-10-14-30-00"]

Notes:
  new takes no body. To add content, edit the file at the printed path (threads/<Kind>/<Name>/notes/<YYYY-MM-DD-HH-MM-SS>.md). Body line markers: ACTION:, AGREED:, RESOLVED:, !:.
  new also queues a REF: to the note in buffer.md; it reaches the thread's daily log on buffer flush.
  Every subcommand except new first runs task ingest, rewriting ACTION: lines in notes and logs in place.
  delete is permanent and fails without -y.
  pdf, minutes and agenda need pandoc and a LaTeX engine.
  Exit 1: empty --topic; --person, --counterparty or --location used with the wrong type; malformed stem; no notes in the vault; PDF render failed.

BLOCKED: delete. These subcommands are refused and calling one returns an error. Do not attempt them.
